messages:
Asha: Quick sync  prepping the newsletter + launch email for the Benchmark webinar. Need final segment, send windows, and a short A/B for subject. Can we lock by EOD?

Bren: Proposal: Segment A = active trials (<7d), Segment B = engaged customers (opens>2 last 30d). Send windows: US 09:00 local, EMEA 10:00 local, APAC 17:30 local.

Carlos: Ops question: do we do timezone send or three distinct passes? Timezone send is cleaner but preview counts differ. Ops: can you confirm ETA for list counts?

ops-bot: Campaign queued: "benchmark-newsletter-2026-05". Timezone send supported. Preview counts (pre-suppression): A=6,200, B=8,450. Suppression & dedupe running. ETA 45m.

Maya: Subject A: "Benchmark webinar: cut inference cost, keep latency" Subject B: "Real-world LLM benchmarks + live Q&A" Preheader: "Join customers & engineers for hands-on results". I prefer B for broader list, A for trial-focused.

Asha: Sounds good. Bren, please add an opens>1 filter for the trial segment to reduce bounce risk. Carlos, when ops-bot posts final counts, share final throttle rec (we usually do 5k/hr ramp).

Bren: Updated rule snippet:
```
WHERE trial_start > now()-7
AND email_opens_last_14 > 1
AND unsubscribed = false
```
Also excluding suppression_marketing_v3.

ops-bot: Final counts post-suppression: A=4,980, B=7,210. Unique emails = 12,090. Recommended throttles: first pass 5k/hr, then 3k/hr.

Carlos: Good. Small ask: include tracking param utm_content=benchmark-newsletter for the launch email and ensure RSVP page has CORS check for the embedded RSVP widget.

Maya: I'll finalize subject variants in the doc and upload both HTML versions to the campaign page: https://docs.redwood.com/campaigns/benchmark-newsletter (draft).

Asha: Perfect  I'll do a final run-through tomorrow morning and post send approval. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
